juvenile delinquency: Experts believe that after-school programs can reduce juvenile delinquency by keeping teenagers busy and away from gangs.
專家認為課後活動能讓青少年保持忙碌、遠離幫派，進而減少青少年犯罪。
juvenile behavior: Throwing food at each other in the restaurant was juvenile behavior for two adults in their thirties.
在餐廳裡互丟食物，對兩個三十幾歲的成年人來說是很幼稚的行為。
a juvenile court: Because the thief was only fifteen years old, his case was sent to a juvenile court instead of a regular one.
因為那名小偷才十五歲，他的案子被移送到少年法庭，而不是一般法院。
juvenile crime: The city has seen a rise in juvenile crime, with more teenagers being caught stealing from shops.
這座城市的少年犯罪增加了，有更多青少年在商店偷竊被抓到。
be keen on sports: My brother is keen on sports; he plays basketball after school and watches baseball games every weekend.
我哥哥熱愛運動；他放學後打籃球，每個週末都看棒球比賽。
be keen to help: As soon as they heard about the flood, many students were keen to help and signed up to volunteer that very day.
一聽到水災的消息，許多學生就很想幫忙，當天就報名當志工。
a keen interest in: Ever since she visited the museum, Emma has had a keen interest in ancient Egypt and its history.
自從參觀博物館後，艾瑪就對古埃及及其歷史產生了濃厚的興趣。
a keen sense of smell: Dogs have a keen sense of smell, so they are often used at airports to find drugs hidden in bags.
狗有敏銳的嗅覺，所以常被派到機場找出藏在行李中的毒品。
keen competition: There is keen competition among students for places at the top medical schools in Taiwan.
學生們為了進入台灣頂尖醫學院的名額而展開激烈的競爭。
a keen observer: As a keen observer of nature, my grandfather can name almost every bird he sees just by its song.
身為敏銳的大自然觀察者，我爺爺光聽鳥叫聲就能說出幾乎每一種他看到的鳥的名字。
keen prices: The new supermarket attracts many shoppers with keen prices that are lower than those at any other store in town.
這家新超市以比鎮上任何商店都便宜的低廉價格吸引了許多顧客。
a lawful owner: The police returned the stolen bike to its lawful owner after checking the receipt she showed them.
警方查核她出示的收據後，把失竊的腳踏車還給了它的合法擁有者。
lawful authority: Only police officers with lawful authority can stop drivers on the road and ask to see their licenses.
只有具備合法權威的警察才能在路上攔下駕駛並要求查看駕照。
go about one's lawful business: Citizens should be able to go about their lawful business without being stopped and searched by the police for no reason.
公民應該能做自己正當的事，而不會無故被警察攔下搜身。
lean meat: To stay healthy, the doctor told my dad to eat more vegetables and lean meat instead of fried pork.
為了保持健康，醫生要我爸爸多吃蔬菜和瘦肉，而不是炸豬肉。
lean years: During the lean years after the war, many families had little food and had to share clothes with their neighbors.
在戰後的荒年裡，許多家庭食物匱乏，還得和鄰居共用衣服。
a lean budget: The club had to plan the school festival on a lean budget, so members made all the decorations themselves.
社團必須用緊縮的預算籌辦校慶，所以社員們自己動手做所有裝飾。
lean and fit: After a year of running and healthy eating, my uncle looks lean and fit, and he has lost ten kilos.
經過一年的跑步和健康飲食，我叔叔看起來精瘦結實，還瘦了十公斤。
lean manufacturing: Toyota became famous for lean manufacturing, a way of producing cars that reduces waste and saves time.
豐田以精實生產聞名，這是一種能減少浪費並節省時間的汽車生產方式。
a learned man: My grandfather was a learned man who could read ancient Chinese poems and discuss history for hours.
我爺爺是位博學之士，能讀古詩，還能連續談論歷史好幾個小時。
learned journals: Professors usually publish their research in learned journals so that other experts can review and discuss it.
教授通常會把研究發表在學術期刊上，讓其他專家審閱和討論。
learned behavior: Scientists say that fear of spiders is partly learned behavior, which children copy from their parents' reactions.
科學家說怕蜘蛛部分是習得的行為，孩子是模仿父母的反應而來的。
a legendary figure: Michael Jordan is a legendary figure in basketball whose amazing skills still inspire young players around the world.
麥可・喬丹是籃球界的傳奇人物，他驚人的球技至今仍激勵著世界各地的年輕球員。
legendary hospitality: The small mountain village is known for its legendary hospitality; visitors are often invited into homes for free meals.
這座小山村以遠近馳名的好客著稱；遊客常被邀請到家中免費吃飯。
achieve legendary status: With ten gold medals and many world records, the swimmer achieved legendary status in her country.
憑藉十面金牌和多項世界紀錄，這位游泳選手在她的國家成為傳奇。
the legislative branch: In a democracy, the legislative branch makes the laws, while the courts decide how those laws should be applied.
在民主國家中，立法部門負責制定法律，而法院則決定這些法律該如何適用。
legislative power: In Taiwan, legislative power belongs to the Legislative Yuan, whose members are elected by the people.
在台灣，立法權屬於立法院，其成員由人民選出。
legislative reform: Many citizens are calling for legislative reform to protect workers from working too many hours without extra pay.
許多公民呼籲進行立法改革，以保護勞工不再超時工作卻拿不到加班費。
